From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Stakeholder mapping & next steps — Hyperion Retail

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the intro call today. Helpful to hear about the pilot goals (improve search relevance, reduce latency on peak traffic windows) and the timeline you shared for procurement in Q1. Per our discussion, can you help map the decision process so we can align the right folks for next steps? Specifically, we’re hoping to get:

- Economic buyer (who signs off on spend)
- Security/infosec contact for a quick architecture review and SOC 2 checklist
- Legal/procurement contact for contracting and standard SOW/terms
- Any ops/infra owners who will validate deployment constraints (VPC, on-prem options)

If it helps, I can draft a one-pager for each audience and set up short intro calls. Goal for us is to provide a tailored mutual action plan and a clear timeline for your procurement team.

Proposed next steps:
1) You share primary contacts or an org chart (even a simple list)
2) I’ll loop in Neha (solutions) and Rishi (sales leadership) for two short 30-min intro sessions next week
3) We’ll follow with a security questionnaire and a draft commercial outline for pilot pricing

Also attaching the quick summary we ran through on the call.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0132
[Attachment: Redwood_Pilot_Summary.pdf (PDF, 120 KB)]

Marissa
